title: Research 5/9: civil-law jurisprudencia constante - does repeated confirmation beat single-decision bindingness
description: Research agenda item 5 (docs/civilizational-roadmap-brief.md:53). Civilian systems formally deny binding precedent yet achieve consistency through settled doctrine. Research at minimum: Mexico's jurisprudencia por reiteracion (the repeated-rulings rule) and the shift toward precedentes obligatorios by qualified majority of the Suprema Corte, plus contradiccion de tesis as the mechanism for resolving divergence; Spain's doctrina jurisprudencial / jurisprudencia reiterada and the conventional two-judgment threshold; France's arrets de principe and jurisprudence constante. Evaluate whether a repeated-confirmation model (a rule binds only after N consistent applications) suits agent societies better than single-decision bindingness. Output docs/precedent-research/05-jurisprudencia-constante.md. Web research, tagged claims, mandatory implications section.

THE 3 FINDINGS THAT MOST CHANGE THE SCHEMA:
1. [ESTABLISHED] Both Mexico (2021 reform, art.94 CPEUM) and Spain (2015/2023/2025 interes casacional objetivo reforms) moved AWAY from repeated-confirmation toward a single, heavily-scrutinized decision, never the reverse - this is the finding that cuts against the roadmap brief's neutral framing of research item 5, and is why this document does NOT recommend a repeated-confirmation replacement of D4 tier 3.
2. [ANALOGY] D4 tier 3's existing single-verdict rule already functions like Mexico's precedentes-obligatorios fast lane (1 ruling + a heightened gate - producer!=approver - substituting for repetition), so N=1 stays as-is; reiteration's only non-duplicative home is a new tier-4-only reiterated flag (recommend N=3, SPECULATION), never a tier-3 replacement or a new auto-binding tier (would violate D1).
3. [ANALOGY] A counter-count is mandatory and must ZERO the counter on a contrary application (not merely skip incrementing it), mirroring Ley de Amparo's "no interrumpidas por otra en contrario" and its interrupcion-de-jurisprudencia mechanism; recognized by reading existing events.jsonl/task-note citation-plus-contradiction patterns, no new log file, per the epic's own non-additive-regression rationale (agentic_harness_engineering.pdf Table 3 RQ3a).
